column3: NKJV has “in Ramah,” where the Hebrew reads “at the high place.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “a covenant” after “my son has made.”
NKJV renders “who was standing with the servants of Saul” as “who was set over the servants of Saul.”
NKJV renders “who turns aside to your bodyguard” as “who goes at your bidding.”
